idea-plugin.name: Flutter Test Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Explore and run Dart and Flutter tests from a native Tests tool window in IntelliJ IDEA.

Flutter Test Explorer builds a focused tree of the tests that the installed Dart and Flutter infrastructure can actually launch. Helpers, unsupported dynamic constructs, and structural branches without runnable tests stay out of the way.

Features

  • Accurate test discovery: finds runnable tests in test/ and integration_test/, including nested packages, directories, groups, and nested groups.
  • Run at any level: start an individual test, group, file, directory, or the complete visible scope using Dart and Flutter run configurations.
  • Precise execution scope: persistent visibility checkboxes control what may run, while text and exclusion search make large suites easier to navigate. Partially included files use exact per-file test filters.
  • Automatic updates: edits, including unsaved editor changes, incrementally rediscover only the affected test file. Manual refresh is not required for normal work.
  • Structured run arguments: add, edit, enable, disable, and reorder individual CLI arguments. The list starts empty; disabled values remain saved without being passed to Dart or Flutter.
  • Native IDE workflow: use inline Run actions, Run Selected, Run All in Visible Scope, keyboard shortcuts, source navigation, and the standard IntelliJ Run tool window.

Run All and directory runs create a safe execution plan per test entrypoint: fully visible files use normal file execution, partially visible files use filtered execution, and excluded files are skipped.

Requirements: the Dart and Flutter plugins, a configured SDK, and a successfully analyzed project. Tests that cannot be represented as reliable IDE run targets are intentionally omitted. Test results are displayed in IntelliJ's standard Run tool windows.
